data.short_description: Dirty soda shop Fiiz Drinks is now open in El Dorado Hills. It is the business's first California location.
Munchie Man opened in downtown Davis with global cuisine from chef Christopher Fairman. Its menu includes rotating featured dishes.
Downtown Commons welcomed a new Sacramento Kings Team Store. The store is 4,000 square feet and operates at 405 K St.

NYC-based Thai seafood restaurant Fish Cheeks is preparing its first Florida location in Wynwood. It is expected to be the group's largest location. Executive Chef Dustin Everett will oversee the kitchen.

Guatemalan restaurant El Quetzal celebrated the grand opening of its second location in downtown Riverhead, in the former Insatiable Eats space. Owner Norma España opened the first location at 1020 E. Main St. in 2021. The new spot serves breakfast, lunch and dinner and offers catering.

data.short_description: Magnolia Bakery, known for its cupcakes and its feature on "Sex and the City," is bringing a location to Mount Laurel. Guests are invited to a grand opening on Tuesday at 10 a.m. It is the chain's first shop in New Jersey, among 24 locations worldwide.

data.status: recently welcomed; celebrated a grand opening last weekend
data.short_description: Bartow Ace opened its third storefront in the renovated former Town and Country building in Mountain View. It had a soft opening September 15 and a grand opening last weekend. The location has 13 employees, including owner Luke Bartow.

Curlo, a fast-casual American restaurant, is coming soon to the Wheaton Triangle. The menu includes cheesesteaks, burgers, wings and milkshakes, all 100% halal. Curlo has an existing location in Alexandria.
The Container Store plans to close its Harford County distribution center in January 2027. The closure affects 183 workers at its Aberdeen warehouse.
According to the LaScala's Fire website, a new Freehold location is coming soon. An official opening date and location were not listed. It is one of three new planned New Jersey locations.
A LaScala's Fire location is planned in Bridgewater as one of three new New Jersey locations. No date or address was given.
A LaScala's Fire location is planned in Princeton as one of three new New Jersey locations. No date or address was given.

data.location: 1980 N. Jefferson St., Huntington Plaza, Huntington, Ind.
data.status: will officially open their doors on Sunday with a ribbon cutting
data.short_description: The Huntington County Chamber of Commerce announced T.J. Maxx will open in Huntington on Sunday, Nov. 15 at 7:45 a.m. with a ribbon cutting. The store is between Maurices and Five Below at Huntington Plaza.

data.status: will close; will begin liquidating its inventory
data.short_description: Palm Springs Ace Hardware will close its Smoke Tree Village location, where it has operated since 2009, when its lease expires Feb. 28, 2027. Owners are seeking a new location in the city but none has been secured. The store will begin liquidating its inventory in the coming days.

data.status: soft opening was held on Tuesday
data.short_description: Fast food restaurant Flayva is opening a second Baton Rouge location on Airline Highway. The soft opening was held Tuesday, and it will operate daily from 10:30 a.m. to 3 a.m. The first store is on Florida Boulevard.

data.store_name: Hazard Medical Clinic and Pharmacy (Mountain Comprehensive Health Corporation)
data.location: 30 S. Ky. 15, across from Black Gold Plaza, Hazard
data.short_description: MCHC celebrated the grand opening of its new Hazard Medical Clinic and Pharmacy on Nov. 5 with a ribbon-cutting ceremony. The facility will bring approximately 30 jobs to the community.

data.location: Tampa Premium Outlets, 2300 Grand Cypress Drive, Lutz
data.short_description: A new Disney Character Warehouse opened at Tampa Premium Outlets on November 9, 2026. It is the third location in the region, joining Orlando International and Orlando Vineland Premium Outlets. The Vineland location is moving into a larger space within its center.

data.location: 6232 Craig Lane (per website) / 6233 Telegraph Road (per city planning documents), Commerce
data.short_description: The first In-N-Out Burger in the City of Commerce will open Thursday, Nov. 12, near Telegraph Road and E. Washington Boulevard. It will have one drive-thru lane, indoor seating for 84 and patio seating for 36. It will employ about 80 people and is the chain's 446th restaurant.
Canadian furniture retailer Article will expand in the Sun Belt with a new store in Austin, Texas. The company operates four stores in North America and plans to open two more next year.

data.location: Atlanta, GA (properties listed: Westside Provisions District, 1198 Howell Mill Rd; Market Provisions District, 1183 Howell Mill Rd)
data.short_description: Canadian furniture retailer Article will expand with a new store in Atlanta. The full story is subscriber-only, so the exact site is not confirmed in the text.

data.status: official opening date has not been set
data.short_description: Convenience chain KaleMart24 has secured a retail space on Ordnance Street in Liberty Village. The store will feature a hybrid concept of everyday essentials and health-conscious merchandise. No official opening date has been set.
The Children's Place, with roughly 500 North American locations, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on Sunday. Its website displays an "All Stores Closing" banner with 30% to 60% discounts.
Neighborhood Intelligence has opened a standalone Bed Bath & Beyond store in Glendale, Arizona. Additional locations are reportedly planned for Minnesota, Florida and Mississippi in 2027.
Toys "R" Us is mounting a return with 120 new standalone stores opening for the holiday season. That brings its U.S. total to 160.

A new Brookshire Brothers flagship store is open in Lufkin, where the company started in 1921. It brings 150 new jobs and has a drive-thru pharmacy, coffee shop and the Pineywoods Pavilion. It is open daily 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.

data.status: providers began moving into the space
data.short_description: Lumina Spa owners Lisa and Ethan Rector are taking over Boone Beauty Bar as their third location. Providers began moving in Nov. 1. The space will rent private suites to independent beauty professionals.

data.status: will close its doors for good
data.short_description: Mex on Main announced it will close for good Nov. 30 as its owners retire from the food business. The restaurant temporarily closed in June after a vehicle crashed into the building.

data.location: 750 N. Midvale Boulevard, Hilldale Shopping Center, Madison, Wis.
data.short_description: Wisconsin's second Cava is opening Wednesday at Hilldale Shopping Center in Madison. It will employ 25 to 40 people. Cava opened its first Wisconsin location last month in Greenfield.

data.status: opened its first store in Florida
data.short_description: Parker's Kitchen opened its first Florida store on Wednesday in Yulee, Nassau County. The store features a hot bar, indoor dining and ordering kiosks. More north Florida stores are planned for 2027.

data.location: Redhawk Pointe, South New Hope Road, Cramerton, North Carolina
data.short_description: Publix is targeting a 2027 opening as the anchor of Redhawk Pointe, a planned shopping center by The Morgan Company. The developer confirmed Publix signed a lease. Project completion was targeted for the third quarter of 2027.
Publix confirmed another upcoming Charlotte-area store in Matthews alongside the Cramerton location. No further details were given.

data.status: closing; last day will be Nov. 21
data.short_description: Carini Pizza & Italian Restaurant is closing after 41 years, its owners announced. Its last day will be Nov. 21 and will include a pasta dinner fundraiser for local schools. Gift cards must be used before then.

data.location: 3401 Oakdale Road, Suite 300, The Marketplace, Modesto
data.short_description: Chipotle says its Modesto location at The Marketplace will open Nov. 18. It features a drive-thru lane and will be open 10:45 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily. The company is hiring around 30 jobs per location.
